label: Trial
description: The trial form beside a photo, then questions.

settings.heading: First class is free
settings.standfirst: One class on us. Bring trainers and water.

settings.text: Tell us a little and we'll book you in. No card needed, no contract after.

settings.question: Which class should I pick?
settings.answer: Strength Foundations or Beginners Strength. If you are not sure, leave it blank and the coach will suggest one.

settings.question: What happens after I book?
settings.answer: A coach calls within a day to fix a time and answer questions.

settings.question: Is the trial really free?
settings.answer: Yes. One class, no card, no catch.
